statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ¬IsCompact univ ∧ ¬IsCompact {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r}
script:
# name: set-plane-disc-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.plane_disc_not_compact
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)', '1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r), ¬ IsCompact (univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ∧ ¬ IsCompact {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} := by
  intro n hn r hr
  haveI : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨noncompact_univ _, fun h => ?_⟩
  -- the boundary point `(√r, 0)` is a limit of points `((1 - t)√r, 0)` of the disc
  set s := Real.sqrt r
  have hs : s ^ 2 = r := Real.sq_sqrt hr.le
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hr
  have hcl := h.isClosed
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (((1 - t) * s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (s, 0)) := by
    have : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (((1 - t) * s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    simpa using (this.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (((1 - t) * s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with t ht
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := ht
    have : (1 - t) ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have := hcl.mem_of_tendsto hlim hev
  simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at this
  nlinarith
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num)) (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)', '1', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r), ¬ IsCompact (univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ∧ ¬ IsCompact {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} := by

  nlinarith
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num)) (1) ((by norm_num))'),
